references.text: Describes the principle of redemption where the value is calculated based on the number of years remaining until the Jubilee year, the same principle applied here for redeeming a slave
States that buying and selling should be based on the number of years remaining until the Jubilee year, which forms the basis for calculating the redemption price
The immediately preceding verse explaining that the redemption price is to be calculated from the year of sale until the Jubilee year based on a day laborer's wage
The context for redeeming an Israelite who has sold himself to a foreigner, and who has the right to redeem him
Laws concerning Hebrew slaves and their release, which form the background for the rules on redemption
Parallel provisions regarding the release of Hebrew slaves and how they are to be treated
